'''Sanetre''' is one of [[Elayne Trakand]]'s bodyguards. 

== Activities ==
She is outside the house on Full Moon Street when the [[Aes Sedai]]'s [[Warder]]s go charging inside. [[Birgitte Silverbow]] get the bodyguards to instead ride back to the royal palace and mount a strike force to try and rescue [[Elayne Trakand]], who is taken captive. Birgitte tells her to bring [[Charlz Guybon]] to her.{{ref/book|11|32}}
